mechanism.claim: During a high-variation completed BTC day, an unusually high Binance spot share of combined spot and perpetual transaction count identifies broad cash-market participation rather than leverage-only price movement. When completed spot and perpetual daily returns agree, follow their common direction for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: common strict nonzero sign of completed spot and perpetual 24h returns
mechanism.why_distinct: SPVIR used hourly base-volume participation plus BVOL/DVOL ignition; HVSFLR used spot-versus-perpetual aggressive-flow imbalance; VTMS used average ticket-size migration on an older source period. STCSR uses the count of executions, not notional volume, taker side, implied volatility, or average ticket, at one daily clock. No terminal control is promoted.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed perpetual 24h realized-variation rank must be at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one daily 08:05 UTC cash transaction-breadth clock is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: exact aligned BTCUSDT bars_binance_spot and bars_binance 1m rows in [prior 08:00,current 08:00); all 1440 timestamps per source
features.trade_counts: finite integer number_of_trades>=0 each minute and positive completed-day total in each source
features.spot_count_share: sum spot number_of_trades divided by sum spot plus perpetual number_of_trades
features.spot_count_share_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 252 prior valid daily blocks; minimum 126; current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.returns: log(last close/first open) independently for spot and perpetual; both strict nonzero and same sign
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared perpetual 1m log(close/open)) over the completed block
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 252 prior valid daily blocks; minimum 126; current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.missing_duplicate_noninteger_or_nonposit: ineligible or source failure; no imputation

clock.decision: each calendar day 08:00 UTC after both source blocks complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent cash transaction-breadth sponsorship plus user-required high volatility

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no clock, threshold, side, hold, timing, volatility, or subset repair
